name: throw-catch-simple
code:
log=[]
def g():
 try:
  yield "pause"
 except ValueError:
  log.append("caught")
  yield "recovered"
it=g()
next(it)
print(it.throw(ValueError("boom")))
print(log)

name: throw-catch-e-type
code:
log=[]
def g():
 try:
  yield "pause"
 except ValueError as e:
  log.append(type(e).__name__)
  yield "recovered"
it=g()
next(it)
print(it.throw(ValueError("boom")))
print(log)
